newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba appoints new Transport Minister.
newsitem.headline: Cuba appoints new Transport Minister.

text.p: Cuba has appointed a new Transport Minister to fill a post vacant since minister Senen Casas died of a heart attack last August, it was announced on Friday.
A brief announcement in the ruling Communist Party daily Granma said the Council of State had named Alvaro Perez Morales to the post. Perez was previously deputy transport minister.
